elsa: Quick train bulletin — please scan. Two small policy updates + a canary note.
elsa: Quiet window set 2025-02-11T23:00Z -> 2025-02-12T07:00Z (8h). New defaults: ramp cap 3%/shard per 5m for any changes touching router or gateway, and a rollback reserve of 4% per shard.
release-bot: Quiet window scheduled for 2025-02-11T23:00:00Z. Ramp and rollback defaults applied.
martin: Heads-up: paused v8.1 canary after seeing intermittent 502s from routing-layer during ramp. No customer impact yet but were pausing to triage.
sre-oncall: Incident recap: 2212-02-10 18:22 UTC - routing-layer returned transient 502s under increased connection churn; spike lasted ~6m and coincided with a change in connection pooling. Auto-pause triggered.
elsa: Because of this, v8.1 is paused for 24h. Owners please run the focused sim and attach traces. If you need to restart, verify the preflight below.
june: Whats the preflight checklist?
elsa: Preflight (required before any unpause): 1) run ./infra/tests/routing_smoke.sh --duration 15m --concurrency 200 2) verify p95 latency delta < 100ms, error-rate < 0.15% 3) run free-capacity check and paste output in PR.
martin: Free-capacity check command?
elsa: Use: ./tools/check_free_capacity.sh --shard <shard-id> --threshold 0.04

Example output required in PR:
```
shard: shard-7
free_capacity_ratio: 0.06
rollback_reserve_required: 0.04
status: OK
```

elsa: If free_capacity_ratio < rollback_reserve_required, raise a spot-check with #release-ops and do not unpause.
sre-oncall: Monitoring note: added routing error-rate and connection churn chart to canary dashboard. Alerts: sustained 502 rate > 0.1% over 5m will auto-pause.
june: Action items recap: 1) routing-owner to run routing_smoke and attach traces (martin) 2) platform to add the free-capacity verifier to the pipeline (elsa) 3) SRE to keep an eye on connection churn (sre-oncall).
martin: Running the smoke now, will post results in ~20m.
release-bot: Canary status: v8.0 = STABLE, v8.1 = PAUSED (auto). Policies: ramp-cap = 3%/5m, rollback-reserve = 4%/shard.
elsa: Final note: hold non-critical merges touching router/gateway until the pause is lifted. Emergency exceptions only during the quiet window; request via #release-ops with two approvers from eng-leads + ops and include the preflight outputs and a rollback plan. Thanks all. :rocket:
